```{r}
#| include: false
library(sf) # vector handling
library(terra) # raster handling
library(tidyverse)
library(tmap) # map making
library(gt)
```



```{r}
#| include: false
# Creating color palette
region_colors <- c("#f6eff7", "#bdc9e1", "#67a9cf", "#1c9099", "#016c59")
```


```{r}
#| output: false
# Reading in rasters and shapefile

annual_temp_08 <- rast(
  "data/average_annual_sst_2008.tif"
)

annual_temp_09 <- rast(
  "data/average_annual_sst_2009.tif"
)

annual_temp_10 <- rast(
  "data/average_annual_sst_2010.tif"
)

annual_temp_11 <- rast(
  "data/average_annual_sst_2011.tif"
)

annual_temp_12 <- rast(
  "data/average_annual_sst_2012.tif"
)


depth <- rast(
  "data/depth.tif"
)

regions <- st_read("data/wc_regions_clean.shp"
)
```


```{r}
# Stacking temperature rasters

temp_stack <- c(annual_temp_08, annual_temp_09, annual_temp_10, annual_temp_11, annual_temp_12)
```


```{r}
# Checking if coordinate reference systems match
if (st_crs(regions) == st_crs(depth)) {
  print("Coordinate reference systems match")
} else {
  warning("Updating coordinate reference system to match")

   # Transform EEZ regions (vector) to match depth CRS,
  regions <- st_transform(
    regions,
    crs(depth)
  )

}
```


```{r}
# Check if coordinate reference systems match
if (crs(temp_stack) == crs(depth)) {
  print("Coordinate reference systems match")
} else {
  warning("Updating coordinate reference system to match")
  
  # Transform raster to match depth CRS
  temp_stack <- project(
    temp_stack,
    crs(depth)
  )
}
```

```{r}
crs(regions, describe = TRUE)$code
```

```{r}
crs(depth, describe = TRUE)$code
```


```{r}
# Mean SST from 2008-2012
mean_sst <- app(temp_stack, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
```


```{r}
# Convert mean SST from Kelvin to Celsius
mean_sst <- mean_sst - 273.15
```


```{r}
# Crop depth to SST extent
depth_crop <- crop(depth, mean_sst)
```

```{r}
# Resample cropped depth to match SST
depth_resampled <- resample(
  depth_crop,
  mean_sst,
  method = "bilinear"
)
```

```{r}
res(depth_resampled)
res(mean_sst)

ext(depth_resampled)
ext(mean_sst)

crs(depth) == crs(mean_sst)
```

```{r}
# Check if depth and SST can be stacked
depth_sst <- c(depth_resampled, mean_sst)
```

```{r}
# Reclassifying SST for oyster suitability
sst_rcl <- matrix(
  c(
    -Inf, 11, 0,
    11, 30, 1,
    30, Inf, 0
  ),
  ncol = 3,
  byrow = TRUE
)

sst_stbl <- classify(mean_sst, rcl = sst_rcl)
```

```{r}
# Reclassifying depth for oyster suitability
depth_rcl <- matrix(
  c(
    -Inf, -70, 0,
    -70, 0, 1,
    0, Inf, 0
  ),
  ncol = 3,
  byrow = TRUE
)

depth_stbl<- classify(depth_resampled, rcl = depth_rcl)

```

```{r}
oyster_stbl <- lapp(c(sst_stbl, depth_stbl), fun=function(sst, depth)sst * depth)

names(oyster_stbl) <- "suitability"

oyster_stbl[oyster_stbl < 1] <- NA

```


```{r}
#| fig-height: 7
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-align: center
#| warning: false
tm_basemap("Esri.NatGeoWorldMap", zoom = 5, alpha = 0.55) +
tm_shape(oyster_stbl) +
  tm_raster(
    col.legend = tm_legend(title = "Suitable Habitat", 
    position = tm_pos_in("left", "bottom"),
    text.size = 0.6,
    title.size = 0.7),
    col.scale = tm_scale_categorical(values = "#dd1c77",
    labels = "11–30 °C,  0–70 m deep")
  ) + 
tm_shape(regions) +
  tm_borders(lwd = .75)  +
 tm_compass(position = c("left", "top"), size = 1.5) +
  tm_scalebar(position = c("left", "bottom"), width = 13) +
tm_title(
  "Suitable Oyster Habitat",
  position = tm_pos_out(
    "center",
    "top",
    pos.h = "center"
  )
) +
tm_layout(inner.margins = c(0.08, 0.10, 0.02, 0.02))
```

```{r}
cell_area <- cellSize(oyster_stbl) / 1e6
```


```{r}
# summarize cell size variation across the extent
global(cell_area, fun = c("mean", "min", "max"))
```

```{r}
region_rast <- terra::rasterize(regions, oyster_stbl, field = "rgn_id")
```

```{r}
# Mask cell sizes to EEZ regions
eez_cell_area<- mask(cell_area, regions)

# Verifying suitability, cell-area and EEZ rasters align
oyster_eez <- c(region_rast, oyster_stbl, eez_cell_area)
```


```{r}
area_stbl <- oyster_stbl * eez_cell_area
```

```{r}
total_suitable_area <- zonal(
  area_stbl,
  region_rast,
  fun = "sum",
  na.rm = TRUE)|>
  rename(suitable_area_km2 = suitability)

total_suitable_area
```


```{r}
oyster_stbla_summ <- total_suitable_area|>
  left_join(
    regions |>
      st_drop_geometry() |>
      select(rgn_id, rgn),
    by = "rgn_id"
  ) |> 
    select(rgn, suitable_area_km2) |> 
    arrange(desc(suitable_area_km2)) |>
    gt() |> 
  tab_header(title = md("Oyster Total Suitable Area")) |>
  cols_label(
    rgn = "Region",
    suitable_area_km2 = md("Total Suitable Area (km^2^)")
  )  |>
  fmt_number(
    columns = suitable_area_km2,
    decimals = 2
  )

oyster_stbla_summ

```


```{r}
regions_area <- regions |>
  left_join(
    total_suitable_area,
    by = "rgn_id"
  )
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 7
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-align: center
tm_basemap("Esri.NatGeoWorldMap", zoom = 5, alpha = 0.55) +
tm_shape(regions_area) +
tm_polygons(
    fill = "suitable_area_km2",
    fill.scale = tm_scale_continuous(
      values = region_colors
    ),
    fill.legend = tm_legend(
      title = "Suitable Area (km²)",
      position = tm_pos_out("right", "center"),
    col = "black",
    lwd = 1
  ) 
)+ 
 tm_compass(position = c("left", "top"), size = 1.5) +
  tm_scalebar(position = c("left", "bottom"), width = 9) +
tm_title(
  "Oyster Suitable Area by EEZ Region",
  position = tm_pos_out(
    "center",
    "top",
    pos.h = "center"
  ), size = 1.2
) +
tm_layout(inner.margins = c(0.08, 0.10, 0.02, 0.02),component.autoscale = FALSE)
```
